notes.title: Update 1.1 [Feb 27, 2019] Trading cards are available!
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 1.1 [Feb 27, 2019][/h1]

-Added Steam Trading Cards

[h1]Fifth level changes "Abandoned Village":[/h1]

- Improved lighting.
-Added new objects, buildings.
-Added two new achievements.
-Now you do not need to search for items to leave the location. Added new scenes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31651950/e3836c488ca1d1042645cd01cc77d05a86d5a792.png[/img]

notes.title: Update: 10/09/2018
notes.notes:
Update: 10/09/2018:

- Removed two scenes at the start of the game (tutorial, scene with a deer)
- The blue filter is removed. Now the colors look more natural.
- Changed lighting in some locations.
- Increased the speed of the search boxes.
- Long monologue in the second location can be canceled with the [F] key
- Changed the picture in the main menu
- The soundtrack of the game is now available for purchase
Also various small gameplay and graphic fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Update 1.01:

- The smoking scene at the gas station was removed, when the players thought they were stuck
- Added task at level 11. After one of the optional endings, the players did not know what to do
- Fixed mistakes in the text
- At the 5th level, the raft boards are now easier to find
- Fixed bugs in some locations

notes.title: Release! Yes!
notes.notes:
It happened! The game finally saw the light and I'm very happy about it.

Thanks for your support!
